requirements: R1: Wire up the missing Knowledge Base features (document storage, full-text search, user roles, and file uploads) by directly patching the existing codebase layers.

slices.title: Patch Knowledge Base functionality gaps
slices.jtbd: When implementing the missing Knowledge Base features for this epic, I want to patch the existing codebase to wire up document storage, search, roles, and uploads without new schema or API, so that the 100% specification gap is resolved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing Knowledge Base endpoints and UI
When a user interacts with document storage, search, or file uploads
Then the system successfully processes the requests using the existing data model
And appropriate tests verify this patched behavior without requiring new UI or API layers.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Knowledge Base specification gap from 100% to 0%

requirements: R1: Fix the coverage audit file generation to perform real specification validation against the codebase instead of returning a hardcoded empty list of gaps.

slices.title: Fix coverage audit generation logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the coverage audit fix for this epic, I want to implement actual specification validation logic, so that falsified success reports are eliminated
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a coverage audit execution against an unimplemented specification
When the audit file is generated
Then it reflects the actual specification gaps instead of a hardcoded empty list
And the generated audit file correctly identifies missing implementations, with unit tests asserting this accuracy.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase coverage audit true positive rate from 0% to 100%

requirements: R1: Implement RBAC and authentication checks on the existing ComplianceGeneratorController endpoints.

slices.title: Add RBAC to ComplianceGeneratorController
slices.jtbd: When implementing RBAC for this epic, I want to secure the ComplianceGeneratorController endpoints, so that unauthorized access vulnerabilities are eliminated
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the ComplianceGeneratorController endpoints
When an unauthenticated user or a user without proper roles attempts access
Then the system rejects the request with a 401 or 403 status
And valid authorized users can successfully access the endpoints, verified by integration tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized endpoint access occurrences to 0

epics.title: Restore Generated Code Invariants
epics.jtbd: When an engineer needs to modify generated service logic, I want them to use append-only overriding components, so that generated files remain read-only and regenerable.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce direct modifications to generated files to 0 occurrences
requirements: R1: Revert direct modifications to com/eneik/generated/service/TaskService.java and extract the custom logic into an append-only overriding component in com.eneik.production.services.

slices.title: Extract TaskService logic to overriding component
slices.jtbd: When fixing the TaskService generated file violation for this epic, I want to extract the manual changes into an overriding component, so that generated code integrity is restored
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the generated TaskService file and a custom implementation requirement
When the system boots
Then the custom logic is applied via an overriding component from the com.eneik.production.services package
And the generated TaskService file is restored to its pristine state without manual edits, with tests validating the override behavior.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% compliance with generated file immutability rule
